candidate_resolution.rule: The scientific candidate is the first parent of the Git commit that introduced this handoff file.
candidate_resolution.reason: The handoff was intentionally committed last after every normative artifact and both no-Actions producer preflights, so its first parent is an immutable complete candidate without requiring a self-referential commit hash inside the handoff.

identity.producer: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol — WP-005 remediation producer
identity.reviewer: UNASSIGNED distinct Independent Semantic Oracle Adjudicator

B1_gold_oracle_circularity_and_gold_prov.resolution: B-oracle cannot see outcome gold or expected frame fields. Query gold and outcome gold are created by two blind independent adjudicators per case, with third adjudication on disagreement; Path A, Path B, scorer, model analyst and teacher roles are forbidden. Outcome gold is frozen before any scored model output and only becomes scorer-visible after B result and registry hashes freeze.

B2_underdefined_semantics.resolution: Canonical JSON/identifiers/scalars, exact typed ordered arguments, scope, opaque version equality, half-open time, finite least fixpoint, duplicate invariance, complete non-minimal evidence-root union, proof normal form, distinct query outcomes and exact policy mappings are frozen independently of implementation.

B3_acceptable_alternative_normal_form_an.resolution: Alternatives use exact canonical normal form, are blindly adjudicated before first model output and cannot be expanded or repaired in place afterward. A newly discovered legitimate ambiguity requires a new benchmark version and invalidates the current confirmatory candidate.

B4_missing_invariant_coverage_matrix.resolution: 18 publication-critical invariants each have positive and negative vectors, mapped mutations, expected Path A/B behavior and scorer fields; the matrix covers all 14 publication score fields.

B5_non_quantitative_human_audit.resolution: Human audit is frozen at 120 deterministic non-sealed TRAIN/DEV cases, seed 157005, 30 per status, mandatory domain/status/difficulty/source-family/mutation-family coverage, two blind reviewers plus adjudicator, >=0.95 global and >=0.90 per-stratum pre-adjudication agreement, zero unresolved disagreements and zero semantic/scorer errors for PASS. Gold creation itself is separate full-registry blind adjudication, not derived from the sampled audit.

B6_untrusted_audit_tool_and_blind_spots.resolution: Audit-tool producer/reviewer roles, privileges, required observation channels, exactly 16 negative controls, positive controls and non-empty fail-closed blind-spot handling are frozen. Actual implementation/execution remains downstream evidence and is not falsely claimed here.

B7_gold_query_agreement_overclaim.resolution: Gold-query execution may validate only formal execution, policy and frame serialization. Natural-question query formation, production end-to-end and oracle-frame renderer ceiling remain separate claim tracks and cannot borrow each other's agreement.

B8_generic_phrase_wrapper_instead_of_sem.resolution: Dedicated stdlib validators parse and cross-check semantic registry, truth table, policy, packet separation, blind gold provenance/governance, invariant/vector/mutation/scorer coverage, human-audit thresholds and audit-tool trust contracts. Local exact-main no-Actions refreeze preflight exited 0 for both semantic/boundary and gold governance.
